## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and results.

## Documentation impact

For LP behavior changes (tools, protocols, actions, fees, UI labels, quote semantics or result states), link the docs update or explain why public docs are unaffected.

For LP documentation changes, name the verified application revision and link the application mirror-update task with its owner. Record any missing rollout evidence or illustrations. Follow `ai_docs/lp-documentation-maintenance.md`.
